title: Collect samples into the set folder, --no-collect, and --library resolution
description:
## Intent

Collect the samples a set uses, or reference them in place; resolve samples from a library.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/collect.rs`: from the timeline's `sources`, the distinct sample files actually played; a project-relative path under `Samples/Imported/` for each, with clashing file names made unique deterministically; each clip's sample reference written relative to the set (and absolute, as the format wants, per `design/daw-set.md`).
- `--no-collect`: absolute paths to where the samples are, nothing copied.
- Library: reuse `compile_from_library` in `crates/apricity-cli/src/main.rs` (`apricity_data::loader`) so `--library` resolves the same files `apricity render --library` does; a sample known to the library but not present locally is an error that says to run `apricity sync pull`.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Samples travel with the set" scenarios pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): collect a DAW set's samples`. Not breaking.
